core_shell.description: CryptPad's outer shell — loads the bootstrap/Sframe framework before the app-specific iframe is initialized. Handles URL trailing-slash redirects.

files.purpose: HTML entry point; loads require.js and bootstraps app-specific main.js
URL redirect helper — adds trailing slash if missing via AJAX probe

pad.purpose: Rich text document editor using CKEditor. Core writing app for CryptPad.
pad.realtime_protocol: ChainPad via hyperjson (OT-like patching for DOM/HTML)

files.purpose: Entry point; loads sframe-app-outer.js instead of a local main.js
Core app logic: CKEditor integration, toolbar, cursor sync, media-tag, comments, realtime
Export to HTML/MD/DOC via turndown + hyperjson
Comment/annotation system for rich text pads
Remote cursor position tracking (other users' caret positions)
Developer documentation for the pad app module

pad.notes: CKEDITOR_GETURL override sets up resource URL resolution. MathJax configured for LaTeX rendering. Uses sframe-app-framework for iframe sandboxing. inner.js loads via sframe-app-outer.js (no main.js in pad/).

drive.purpose: File management and document browser — the main dashboard/home view. Tree navigation, search, tags, trash.

files.purpose: Outer shell init via sframe-common-outer, loads iframe
Core drive UI: file listing, tree, search, sorting
Full file browser UI: tree rendering, drag-drop, context menus, uploads
Export/download helpers for files and folders (ZIP)
Extensive drive styling (tree, grid, modals, toolbar, colors)

drive.notes: Largest app by total lines (6051). Uses 'drive-app' as app type. drive-ui.js at 2555 lines is the single largest file. Tree view shows nested CryptPad folders. Supports grid/list/compact views. Full drag-drop between folders.

code.purpose: Code/markdown editor with syntax highlighting. Supports multiple programming languages.

files.purpose: Core logic: CodeMirror integration, language switching, rendering mode
Code editor styling, line numbers, theme

code.notes: Supports rich text (rendered) and source code modes. Uses 'code' as app type. Can render Markdown preview alongside source.

sheet.purpose: Spreadsheet editor — full-featured with formulas, charts, and formatting via OnlyOffice.

files.purpose: Outer shell init + OnlyOffice config load
Full OnlyOffice integration: sheet API, toolbar, export, realtime sync

sheet.notes: Uses 'sheet' as app type. Ships bundled OnlyOffice scripts via //sdk/scripts/ onlyoffice-*. Bundles its own realtime sync layer. Largest inner.js for OnlyOffice-based apps.

slide.purpose: Presentation/slide deck editor with Markdown-based slides. Live preview as you type.

files.purpose: Core app: CodeMirror editor, slide rendering, formatting toolbar, timer
Slide engine: pagination, transitions, resize, speaker support

slide.purpose_of_slide_js: Custom slide renderer — splits content by <hr> separator, manages page index, transitions, font scaling based on viewport (20vh base), separate fullscreen presentation view
slide.notes: Slides are written in Markdown and split by page break (<hr>). Rendered with a custom iframe-based slide viewer (not reveal.js). Supports speaker mode and presentation mode.

doc.purpose: Word processor document editor via OnlyOffice — the most feature-rich writing tool.

files.purpose: Full OnlyOffice document API integration, toolbar, realtime sync, export

doc.notes: Uses 'doc' as app type. OnlyOffice document editor with collaborative editing, comments, and track changes.

form.purpose: Form builder — create surveys, quizzes, and data collection forms with drag-and-drop.

files.purpose: Core form logic: builder, response collection, realtime
Form UI components, question types, drag-drop builder

form.notes: Uses 'form' as app type. Dual-mode: form builder (edit) and form response (fill). Supports multiple question types (text, choice, rating, date, etc.). Responses stored as separate documents linked to the form.

kanban.purpose: Kanban board for task/project management — columns, cards, drag-drop ordering.

files.purpose: Core kanban logic: column/card CRUD, drag-drop, realtime sync, export
Kanban board styling (columns, cards, colors, drag states)

kanban.notes: Uses 'kanban' as app type. Tag/color system for cards. Custom scroll per column. Responsive layout adapts number of visible columns.

poll.purpose: Event scheduling and polling — propose dates/times and collect responses.

files.purpose: Core poll logic: options, votes, scheduling grid, comments
Poll timetable UI — horizontal date/time grid, availability entry

poll.notes: Uses 'poll' as app type. Horizontal timeline-style scheduler. Each option is a row, responders fill in availability columns. Supports free-text comments per option.

todo.purpose: Task list manager — hierarchical todo lists with checkboxes, tags, and due dates.

files.purpose: Core todo logic: task CRUD, checkboxes, tree structure, tags, realtime
Todo app styling (tree, tags, checkboxes, progress)

todo.notes: Uses 'todo' as app type. Nested/hierarchical task lists. Progress tracking (completed vs pending). Tag system for categorization. Supports expand/collapse of subtasks.

calendar.purpose: Event calendar — create, view, and manage events in day/week/month views.

files.purpose: Core calendar logic: event CRUD, views, recurrence, invitations
Calendar rendering engine: day/week/month grid, event positioning, drag-drop

calendar.notes: Uses 'calendar' as app type. Supports recurring events. Day/week/month views with drag-to-create. External calendar import/export (ICS). Color-coded calendars/tags.

diagram.purpose: Diagram editor — create flowcharts, mind maps, and technical diagrams.

files.purpose: Outer init + iframe load + draw.io preloader
App iframe shell with draw.io container
Core diagram logic: draw.io integration, realtime, load/save, export

diagram.notes: Uses 'diagram' as app type. Bundles draw.io's full diagramming library. Each diagram stores XML internally, rendered via mxGraph. Preloads draw.io scripts in main.js before iframe init.

whiteboard.purpose: Freehand drawing/canvas whiteboard with brush, shapes, and text tools.

files.purpose: Core whiteboard logic: canvas drawing tools, realtime, export

whiteboard.notes: Uses 'whiteboard' as app type. Canvas-based drawing with brush sizes, colors, shapes (rect, ellipse, line), text tool, and undo/redo. Pointer tool for selecting/moving drawn objects.

file.purpose: File/media viewer — view embedded images, PDFs, audio, video within CryptPad.

files.purpose: Core file viewer: media-tag rendering, metadata display, download

file.notes: Uses 'file' as app type. Not an editor — a viewer for uploaded media files. Uses CryptPad's media-tag system for decryption and rendering. Supports images, video, audio, PDF, and other file types.

presentation.purpose: Presentation viewer — view slide decks created by the 'slide' app in presentation mode.

files.purpose: Core presentation viewer: fullscreen slide display, navigation, export

presentation.notes: Uses 'presentation' as app type. Read-only view of 'slide'-type documents. Fullscreen presentation mode with keyboard navigation. Optimized for projection/displays.

admin.purpose: Server administration panel — manage users, servers, and system settings.

files.purpose: Admin panel HTML with form controls
Full admin UI: user management, limits, logs, OOnlyOffice, system info

admin.notes: Largest utility by far at 2501 lines in inner.js. Comprehensive admin dashboard with server stats, user management, and legal notice management.

settings.purpose: User settings/preferences — profile, account, appearance, cryptography, and subscription management.

files.purpose: Settings page HTML with tab structure (account, appearance, crypto, etc.)
Core settings logic: preference management, 2FA, password change, crypto keys

settings.notes: Multi-tab settings: Account, Appearance, Cryptography, Feedback, Experimental, Subscriptions. Manages user crypto keys and 2FA setup.

teams.purpose: Team/group management — create and manage teams, shared drives, and member roles.

files.purpose: Team/group management UI: create, members, roles, shared drives

teams.notes: Team creation with cryptographic key sharing. Role-based permissions (owner, admin, member, viewer). Shared drives per team.

contacts.purpose: Contact/address book management — add, search, and organize friends/contacts.

files.purpose: Core contacts: list, add friend, search, delete, friend requests

contacts.notes: Friend request system. Contact list with search/filter. Integration with pad/document sharing workflow.

profile.purpose: User public profile page — avatar, display name, bio, and social links.

files.purpose: Profile display/edit: avatar, display name, bio, curve color

profile.notes: Public profile visible to other users. Editable avatar (uploaded/encrypted), display name, bio, social media links, and cursor color preference.

notifications.purpose: Notification center — incoming friend requests, share notifications, and system alerts.

files.purpose: Notification rendering: list, filter, mark read, clear all

notifications.notes: Aggregates share notifications, friend requests, team invitations, and system messages. Read/unread states with bulk actions.

support.purpose: Support/admin contact form — report issues and contact instance administrators.

files.purpose: Reusable support ticket UI component (also used by moderation)

support.notes: Reuses /support/ui.js shared component. Allows users to submit encrypted support tickets to instance admins. Admin response via moderation panel.

moderation.purpose: Moderation/admin panel — manage reported content, user bans, and support tickets.

files.purpose: Moderation UI: reports list, user bans, server-wide actions, ticket responses

moderation.notes: Admin-only access. Uses sidebar-layout from common/inner/. Shares support UI component for ticket responses. User management (ban/unban, limits).

auth.purpose: Authentication (login) via sframe-common-outer — shared auth bootstrap for iframed apps.

files.purpose: Auth bootstrapper via sframe-common-outer (no app of its own)

auth.notes: Minimal bootstrap. Auth is handled by customize/login.js loaded from common/. This exists as a wrapper target for authentication redirect.

login.purpose: Login page — user authentication entry point.

files.purpose: Login logic: form handling, password auth, 2FA, SSO redirects

login.notes: Supports password login, 2FA TOTP, SSO/OpenID Connect, and hardware key (WebAuthn) authentication.

files.purpose: Registration form HTML with terms and fields
Registration logic: form validation, account creation, quota display

register.notes: Registration form with username, password, email (optional). Displays server limits/quota. Terms acceptance required.

recovery.purpose: Account recovery — password reset and account recovery via recovery code.

files.purpose: Account recovery logic: recovery code validation, password reset

recovery.notes: Uses cryptographic recovery keys (not email-based reset). Requires recovery code generated during initial account setup.

checkup.purpose: Server diagnostics/configuration checkup — validates whether the CryptPad server is correctly configured.

files.purpose: Comprehensive checkup: 100+ assertion tests validating server config, OnlyOffice, pin, network, storage, etc.

checkup.notes: Second largest utility at 1812 lines. Runs extensive test suite (Assertions module) covering: API config, WebSocket, ChainPad, OnlyOffice, pinning, storage limits, CORS headers, CSP headers, WebWorker support, and more. Color-coded pass/fail/warning per test.

debug.purpose: Developer debug tool — inspect ChainPad state, document history, and internal state.

files.purpose: Debug interface: ChainWalk chain viewer, document state inspector

debug.notes: Loads /debug/chainpad.dist.js (ChainWalk) for ChainPad chain visualization. Inspects document history, checkpoints, and metadata. Realtime log of operations. Developer-only tool (not user-facing).

convert.purpose: File format converter — import Office documents (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX) into CryptPad editor formats.

files.purpose: Conversion UI: file upload -> X2T conversion -> create new doc in target format

convert.notes: Uses /common/outer/x2t.js (OnlyOffice X2T conversion binary). Supports: DOCX->doc, XLSX->sheet, PPTX->slide. Handles .msg (Outlook email) to doc conversion. Also converts other formats into CryptPad's format. Single-use conversion then redirect.

worker.purpose: Dedicated WebWorker page — runs Sframe iframe-based worker scripts.

files.purpose: Minimal worker bootstrap via sframe-common-outer with noRealtime:true

worker.notes: Smallest utility. Provides an iframe-isolated WebWorker context. Used for background processing tasks that need sandboxed access.

unsafeiframe.purpose: Unsafe iframe wrapper — loads external URLs in a sandboxed iframe for third-party content.

files.purpose: Minimal bootstrap — loads URL from hash and opens in iframe

unsafeiframe.notes: Used to embed third-party/external content (e.g., oEmbed previews, external media) within CryptPad's sandboxed environment. No realtime or crypto involved.

bounce.purpose: URL bounce/redirect safety page — validates and warns before navigating away from CryptPad.

files.purpose: URL validation: referrer check, protocol block (javascript:/data:/blob:), cross-origin warning dialog

bounce.notes: Security-critical: validates URLs before redirecting. Blocks 'javascript:', 'vbscript:', 'data:', 'blob:' protocols. Confirms cross-origin navigation with user. Removes window.opener to prevent reverse tabnabbing.

logout.purpose: Logout page — clears local session data and redirects.

files.purpose: Logout logic: clear localStorage/indexedDB cache, redirect to login

logout.notes: Clears cached documents from client-side storage and redirects to login page.

secureiframe.purpose: Secure content iframe — sandboxed frame for rendering ciphered content (previews, media).

files.purpose: Secure content rendering: media decryption and display
Outer init with secure iframe config

secureiframe.notes: Used for rendering encrypted content previews from other apps. Has its own inner.html (no separate index.html serving as fallback). Stricter sandboxing than standard iframe.

report.purpose: Content reporting page — report abusive/inappropriate content to instance moderators.

files.purpose: Report submission: block hash loading, report type selection, encrypted submission, recaptcha

report.notes: Allows users to report documents for moderation. Requires login. Encrypted submission sent to admins. Supports reCAPTCHA anti-spam.

ssoauth.purpose: SSO/OIDC authentication handler — processes OpenID Connect callback redirects.

files.purpose: SSO callback handler: parse OIDC response, create/authenticate user

ssoauth.notes: Handles OpenID Connect and CAS single sign-on authentication callbacks. Validates token, maps user info, creates account if needed, then redirects.

nextcloud.purpose: Nextcloud integration — embeds CryptPad documents within Nextcloud via iframe.

files.purpose: Nextcloud integration handler: CORS-aware iframe embed

nextcloud.notes: Thin wrapper for the Nextcloud-CryptPad integration. Renders document in iframe with Nextcloud-specific headers. Reuses CryptPad's standard document loading flow.

architectural_notes.app_bootstrap_pattern: Most apps follow a 3-file pattern: index.html -> main.js (sframe-common-outer init iframe) -> inner.js (sframe-common app logic).
architectural_notes.anomaly_no_main_js: The 'pad' app has no main.js in its directory — index.html loads sframe-app-outer.js directly from /common/, bypassing the local pattern.
architectural_notes.common_reuse_pattern: All apps depend on /common/ modules (sframe-common, common-interface, common-util, common-hash, etc.) for shared functionality. Each app's inner.js uses the Sframe app framework for sandboxed realtime editing.
architectural_notes.realtime_protocol: All collaborative apps use ChainPad (operational transformation variant) via chainpad-netflux and chainpad-listmap for realtime synchronization. OnlyOffice apps (sheet, doc) add OnlyOffice's own document sync on top of ChainPad.
architectural_notes.crypto_model: Documents are encrypted client-side using TweetNaCl (X25519/XSalsa20-Poly1305). Keys are embedded in document URLs as hash fragments (#) and never sent to the server.
